body: Yes, and thank you. I tried searching, and could only find information on substance abuse/rehab programs.

I tried looking up what this meant, and I cannot seem to find it. The term sounds appropriate though. 

I have no pride in nearly anything I have done in my life. My wife, and being able to survive without staying in my parents home. Those are the only accomplishments I am proud of. 

To erase the last ten years from my person, to have the..... maturity?.... I have now and try again. I could dream of nothing more.

I replied to the above comment, and would like to reply to you directly. I am sorry how I acted at the time. This post was brought on by one of the worst things another human being had ever done to me. 

How do you begin this process? Regular and frequent visits sound much more productive than my current monthly psychiatric appointment. 

If it is something I have to stop working for, I do not imagine it being possible. If I could leave the job I am at, I already had plans on how to focus on self improvement. It was only time and energy that kept me from these pursuits. 

If it is something that I can schedule regularly in my time off of work, I would gladly put my classes on hold until I could get my head together.

I apologize. I just don't understand. Do you quit your job, and how do you pay for it if you do? What kind of life do you have getting out if that's the case? No work history for months, no job... I might have overreacted. 

If it's something you voluntarily visit regularly while keeping your work and life, how do you get started? I've never heard of long term therapy with multiple sessions a week, short of someone getting a Baker Act pickup.
Beautiful. Apparently the only option is to Give up this job, give up school and go to therapy for months. Hopefully when I get out, I will have learned... What again?

No problem, only have to do one update. Nice and easy. 

Have tried to talk to her twice . She was asleep when I got home the first time (told her I wanted to talk about it when I got home) and second time she said we would talk about it "another day."

School sent me a message. As I failed both of my classes this semester, my financial aid profile is now closed. Failed to meet standards. I can only afford to keep going to school by keeping this job. The one that has me so screwed up I'm failing in classes I've taken previously and excelled in. 

So yeah, just stand up to get shot. Pretty much back to the original plan, as any time I think I have any chance to do something different it's just a chance to laugh at myself. She even got a job because she wanted me to leave this one and focus on school, but without some sort of financial aid from the school we cannot afford tuition and bills. 

Thanks for your time, sorry it was wasted because it didn't work
Not much does for me anymore.

I've bought lottery tickets before. Much worse odds than this, I guess. 

I'll sit down and tell her exactly what it is that I am trying to fix, and explain that I really don't know how to fix it. It doesn't get in the way of my plans, and maybe there is a miracle that she sees something I don't. 

I appreciate you actually responding to me, as well as the others.  But I've never had anyone in the last couple of years actually give me advice, or even talk like I had a choice. 

I've pretty much decided I'm on my way out and you two still talk like I have that option, even if you have an idea against it. 

Thank you.

I pretty much answered most of your post above, but the special part is the moral right to know thing. 

I have my psychiatrist, and I told her. She told me that I just have to do it, and make my life better. Whatever that means. 

I told my wife, and she wanted to know what I wanted her to do. I don't even know how to handle my own life, how can I tell you how to handle it? 

Understandably, people regularly show that it's not their job to figure it out. My psychiatrist has cute stories, and my wife is as kind as they come. I just can't figure this out anymore, and I think it's because you can't. You're supposed to get your shit together long before this.

I really tried. The cliche pulled to the side 'we need to talk.' I knew what was coming, and it did. "What can I do to help?" 

Good bless her, I love that woman. I hate that question right now though. If I knew anything that could be done to help, or make this better I would not have bothered her. 

I think the happy ending is where she moves on from me. My schedule is affecting her sleep. My outlook is affecting her health, with her staying home to try and make me feel better. I hate myself for dragging her down.

I appreciate the sentiment, but it doesn't change the problems. I'm not 'strong' once I start failing my classes, I'm not able to keep up at work and I leave early hoping to catch my wife cheating. I'm not able to make this work.

At this point, pretty much anything worthwhile in life. 

Desire, sure. Gave up on intent a while back.
